llm_unavailable.title: The model is not running
llm_unavailable.action: Open LM Studio, start the server, load the model and press “Try again”.

llm_timeout.title: The model took too long
llm_timeout.action: Wait a little and try again. If it keeps happening, raise LLM_TIMEOUT_SEC on the server.

llm_rate_limited.title: Too many requests to the model
llm_rate_limited.action: Wait a couple of minutes and try again. A longer delay in Settings helps.

llm_bad_answer.title: The model gave an unreadable answer
llm_bad_answer.action: Press “Try again”: it usually works the second time.

llm_auth.title: No access to the model
llm_auth.action: Check the LLM_API_KEY on the server.

llm_model_not_found.title: Model not found
llm_model_not_found.action: Load the model in LM Studio and check its name in LLM_MODEL.

llm_rejected.title: The model refused the request
llm_rejected.action: Try again. If it repeats, show the details to a specialist.

llm_server_error.title: The model service failed
llm_server_error.action: Wait a minute and try again.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.action: Try again. If it repeats, show the details to a specialist.

backend_down.title: No connection to the server
backend_down.action: Check that the server is running and try again.

job_running.title: An evaluation is already running
job_running.action: Wait until it ends: progress is shown at the top of the page.

conversation_not_found.title: Dialog not found
conversation_not_found.action: Refresh the page and import the dataset again.

channel_excluded.title: Calls are not sent to the model
channel_excluded.action: This is the EXCLUDE_CHANNELS setting: real recordings are not sent to a cloud service.

no_evaluation.title: This dialog has no evaluation yet
no_evaluation.action: Evaluate the dialog first, then apply the checklist.
